name: 21069-decode550-8bfp8-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:2, NVLink between them), one in-process vLLM engine.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one engine, one node.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM, 8B), linear weights and activations fp8 with static per-tensor scales, norms and KV cache bf16; ~9 GB of weights over 2 shards, ~4.5 GB per GPU at TP=2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 240 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed static 21069.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed 550 prompt tokens in and exactly 150 out (min == max == mean on both), `ignore_eos`, `temperature: 0.0` for greedy sampling. Rows are rendered through the chat template and re-tokenized with add_special_tokens, so the engine reports a prompt-token count a few above 550.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant streaming short 150-token replies from brief prompts on two linked GPUs.
launch:
# The served engine configuration.

model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 2

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# KV admission is pinned to a count rather than left to fall out of free memory.
block-size: 16
num-gpu-blocks-override: 16384

enable-prefix-caching: false

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE, as inline JSON. Re-flowing this into block style drops the
# key and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
compilation-config: {"level": 3, "custom_ops": ["+quant_fp8", "+rms_norm"], "pass_config": {"enable_fi_allreduce_fusion": true, "enable_noop": true, "enable_fusion": false}}
